title: Fast to First: Carondelet's 1996 state champions
summary: Carondelet's first state championship in any sport came in cross country. Coached by Helen Lehman-Winters, the 1996 team won the NCS Division III title with 21 points, then took the CIF State Division III title by 24 points. Kristen Gordon won the state individual title in 17:17 and went on to win the Foot Locker national championship. The team was the first inducted into the Carondelet Athletics Hall of Fame.
context: Carondelet competed in the Bay Valley Athletic League in that era, before joining the EBAL.
